rule: Return only this JSON object, with nothing before or after it, and with the rule and qualities fields unchanged. The text field holds a passage. The scores field rates that passage from 1 to 5 on each quality, and weakest names the quality scored lowest; if scores is empty, score the passage yourself first. Revise the passage so that its weakest quality is stronger, changing as little else as you can: the same passage, not a new one, at about 250 words. Then score the revised passage honestly on every quality, set weakest to the lowest-scored quality (break ties toward the quality bolstered least recently, per history), append the quality you bolstered this time to history, and put one sentence on what you changed in note.

qualities.floridity: richness and ornament of the language
qualities.relatability: the reader recognizes their own life in it
qualities.scope: sweep; how much world and time it reaches
qualities.strangeness: the familiar made unfamiliar; a life unlike the reader's
qualities.surprise: what the reader did not see coming

text: The sun was setting behind the hills.
